title: Finite bit construction: two neutral R439 moves jointly save two ADDs
body:
On the frozen PR967 bit circuit, a restored target XOR and a restored helper XOR each have zero complete saving alone, but together reduce **11,783 to 11,781 ADDs**. An exact two-by-two interaction bound proves that two is the maximum saving in the fixed one-target/one-helper class with nonpositive unilateral gains. This is a **finite construction and scoped neighborhood result; no new kappa**.

The full domain contains 2,334,050,706 pairs. A proved bound excludes 2,333,917,483; direct enumeration of the remaining 133,223 finds 85 one-ADD and six two-ADD improvements. The declared seed-13 rule fully prices the first 32 nominees; eight pass precision, and the first admitted two-ADD witness is retained. No descent or restart is performed. The frozen parent preparation gates and all four new preparation/restoration gates are charged literally.

The paid profile, all MOVE/COPY/ERASE records and forward/reverse positive maxima remain unchanged. The inherited syntactic H2 and literal K_equals_D failures remain explicit; semantic D and all 661 dirty-input columns pass in both directions. Native multistage execution, whole-hosted admission and full supplier/outer invoices are not claimed. PR967 is not asserted to be a one-sided local optimum, and cheaper circuits already exist in other classes.

Reproduce with Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-neutral-mixed-shears-seed13
```

Expected markers: `PASS_R439_NEUTRAL_MIXED_SHEARS` (18 rejection controls) and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

Validation: packed-bit search and independent set-valued reconstruction agree on the complete census and all 32 invoices; original geometry/export checks pass. Registered Python 3.12, isolated optimized Python 3.11, and relocated optimized Python 3.12 replays agree. The 25 selected-result and nine finite-bit-contract tests pass. No selected-supplier cold replay was run.

Base: `cd91ac8e2652bfee6bf09da3b8724253bcf78f5f`. Every consumed input has SHA256/Git-blob pins in SOURCES.json. Upstream refresh at `410026dc5513b87db92ae98571d1d5984c69a983` leaves all ten source/context pins unchanged. The final overlap snapshot covers 796 open PR records; PR1400's helper-only descent, PR1040/1047's one-sided neighborhoods and PR1122/1188/1208's shorter words are distinct and credited. Only the new research directory is added.

Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1418
